_about: The N-400 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter (schemas/cover_letter.json); the subject, enclosures and fee note are the application's. No priority-date paragraph. The mailing address follows the client's state on USCIS's N-400 chart (schemas/uscis_lockboxes_n400.json. Different from the family-based chart: Massachusetts N-400s go to Elgin). Fee per Form G-1055 (10/01/26): $760 on paper; $380 when the fee reduction is requested. The attorney approves this file before volume use.

forms.g28_n400: Applicant’s G-28 - Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative

documents: Copy of Applicant’s Permanent Resident Card (front and back)
Copies of Divorce Decrees Ending Prior Marriages
Copy of Spouse’s U.S. Birth Certificate
Copy of Spouse’s Certificate of Naturalization or Citizenship
Copies of Applicant’s Immigration Court Documents
Copies of Household Federal Tax Returns
fees: Enclosed is the filing fee of {n400} for Form N-400 ({schedule}).

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
N-400: the client signs Part 11 and the attorney signs Part 13. Parts 15 and 16 stay blank. They are signed at the interview and the oath ceremony.
Enclose the N-400 fee by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount in the cover letter.

fees_when.fees: Enclosed is the reduced filing fee of {n400_reduced} for Form N-400, with the evidence of household income Part 10 requires ({schedule}).
